explication: This repository is a family of OCR-free multimodal language-model projects for documents, charts, scientific diagrams, and visually situated language tasks. The typical user workflow is to submit an image and prompt through a demo, prepare image/text inputs, generate a model response, and optionally evaluate it; separate training pipelines prepare datasets and fine-tune models. The graph preserves the README’s major product branches. Some subsystem links are documented only at README level or are omitted where sampled source does not establish the runtime connection.
